questions.stem: How can scurvy be treated and prevented?

options.text: By taking iron supplements and eating red meat
By spending more time in sunlight
By eating foods rich in vitamin C, such as citrus fruits and vegetables
By increasing protein intake in the diet

questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by vitamin C deficiency and can be treated and prevented by eating foods rich in vitamin C, such as oranges, lemons, strawberries, and green vegetables.
